scenarios.name: Cancel a sketch line color change

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
a dimensioned sketch is nested under an extrusion in the MCAD Software
the user opens Properties from the sketch row context menu
the user opens the Line Color list
the list offers Default, Black, Red, Yellow, Green, Cyan, Blue, Magenta and White
the Line Color field displays Red and Apply is enabled
the user clicks Cancel and reopens the sketch properties
the Line Color field displays Default and Apply is disabled
